marks.description: One entry for each script line that has at least one mark. Most lines have none and are left out.

line.description: The number of the line in the script.

emphasis.description: Each word or short phrase of the line's text that the author set in italics for emphasis, spelled as the script spells it, in order. Otherwise empty array.

focus.description: The one word of the line's text that takes the main stress because the line contrasts or corrects something, otherwise empty string.

heteronyms.description: One entry for each word of the line's text whose pronunciation the context decides (read, lead, wind, tear, live), otherwise empty array.

word.description: The word as the script spells it.

sounds_like.description: A common respelling of how it sounds in this line, such as "red" or "reed".

emotion.description: One or two words for the feeling the line's direction names, otherwise empty string.

energy.description: How loud the line's direction says the line is, otherwise empty string.

pace.description: The pace the line's direction gives, otherwise empty string.
